lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Large, high-luminance circular blobs are arranged in a regular grid-like pattern posterior to the gills. They form distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows, with each blob positioned roughly equidistant from its neighbors within the same column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity run perpendicular to the horizontal ridges. These bands delineate the boundaries of columns; the high-luminance blobs are located in the center of the rectangular regions defined by the intersection of these vertical bands and the horizontal ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank. These features show a sharp vertical gradient from light on the ridge peak to shadow immediately below. They maintain a roughly parallel trajectory starting behind the head and tapering towards the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small white spots. These are primarily located in the anterior and central regions of the fin's lateral surface, with approximately 10 discrete points visible.
dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits displays a transition to significantly smaller, more densely packed, and irregularly arranged high-luminance points compared to the structured grid pattern on the flank.
